    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onClientTick(TickEvent.ClientTickEvent event) {
        if (event.phase != TickEvent.Phase.END) return;

        Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
        if (mc.player == null) return;

        // Р В¤Р ВР С™Р РЋ: Р СћР В°Р в„–Р СР ВµРЎР‚ РЎРѓР В±РЎР‚Р В°РЎРѓРЎвЂ№Р Р†Р В°Р ВµРЎвЂљРЎРѓРЎРЏ Р СћР С›Р вЂєР В¬Р С™Р С› Р ВµРЎРѓР В»Р С‘ Р С‘Р С–РЎР‚Р С•Р С” Р В¶Р С‘Р Р†, Р Р…Р Вµ Р Р† Р Р…Р С•Р С”Р В°РЎС“РЎвЂљР Вµ Р В РЎС“ Р Р…Р ВµР С–Р С• Р Р…Р ВµРЎвЂљ Р С•РЎвЂљР С”РЎР‚РЎвЂ№РЎвЂљР С•Р С–Р С• РЎРЊР С”РЎР‚Р В°Р Р…Р В° РЎРѓР СР ВµРЎР‚РЎвЂљР С‘
        if (mc.player.isAlive() && !mc.player.getPersistentData().getBoolean("AAS_IsDowned") && !(mc.screen instanceof AASDeathScreen)) {
            if (ClientData.globalDeathTimestamp != 0) {
                // Р вЂќР С•Р С—Р С•Р В»Р Р…Р С‘РЎвЂљР ВµР В»РЎРЉР Р…Р В°РЎРЏ Р С—РЎР‚Р С•Р Р†Р ВµРЎР‚Р С”Р В°: Р Р…Р Вµ РЎРѓР В±РЎР‚Р В°РЎРѓРЎвЂ№Р Р†Р В°Р ВµР С, Р ВµРЎРѓР В»Р С‘ Р СРЎвЂ№ Р С—РЎР‚Р С•РЎРѓРЎвЂљР С• Р С—Р ВµРЎР‚Р ВµРЎвЂ¦Р С•Р Т‘Р С‘Р С Р СР ВµР В¶Р Т‘РЎС“ Р СР ВµР Р…РЎР‹РЎв‚¬Р С”Р В°Р СР С‘ AAS
                if (!(mc.screen instanceof com.example.aas.client.gui.PlayerKitSelectScreen) &&
                        !(mc.screen instanceof com.example.aas.client.gui.MapMarkerGridScreen)) {
                    ClientData.globalDeathTimestamp = 0;
                    ClientData.deathFadePlayed = false;
                }
            }
        }

        // === Р Р°РґРёР°Р»СЊРЅРѕРµ РјРµРЅСЋ РјРµС‚РѕРє: РµСЃР»Рё РєР»Р°РІРёС€Р° Р·Р°Р¶Р°С‚Р° РґРѕР»СЊС€Рµ РїРѕСЂРѕРіР° вЂ” РѕС‚РєСЂС‹РІР°РµРј РјРµРЅСЋ ===
        if (radialKeyHeld && !radialScreenOpened && mc.screen == null) {
            long held = System.currentTimeMillis() - radialKeyPressTime;
            if (held >= RADIAL_HOLD_MS && ModKeyBindings.PLACE_PING_KEY.isDown()) {
                radialScreenOpened = true;
                mc.setScreen(new WorldMarkerRadialScreen());
            } else if (!ModKeyBindings.PLACE_PING_KEY.isDown()) {
                // РєР»Р°РІРёС€Сѓ СѓР¶Рµ РѕС‚РїСѓСЃС‚РёР»Рё, Р° СЃРѕР±С‹С‚РёРµ СЂРµР»РёР·Р° РїРѕС‡РµРјСѓ-С‚Рѕ РЅРµ РїРѕР№РјР°Р»Рё (РїРѕС‚РµСЂСЏ С„РѕРєСѓСЃР° РѕРєРЅР°
                // Рё С‚.Рї.) вЂ” РїСЂРѕСЃС‚Рѕ РїРѕРґС‡РёС‰Р°РµРј СЃРѕСЃС‚РѕСЏРЅРёРµ, РЅРёС‡РµРіРѕ РЅРµ СЃС‚Р°РІРёРј, С‡С‚РѕР±С‹ РЅРµ Р±С‹Р»Рѕ "СЃР»СѓС‡Р°Р№РЅС‹С…" РјРµС‚РѕРє
                radialKeyHeld = false;
            }
        }

        if (ClientData.voteActive && ClientData.voteTimer > 0) {
            // Р С™Р В°Р В¶Р Т‘РЎвЂ№Р Вµ 20 РЎвЂљР С‘Р С”Р С•Р Р† (1 РЎРѓР ВµР С”РЎС“Р Р…Р Т‘Р В°) РЎС“Р СР ВµР Р…РЎРЉРЎв‚¬Р В°Р ВµР С Р Р†Р С‘Р В·РЎС“Р В°Р В»РЎРЉР Р…РЎвЂ№Р в„– РЎвЂљР В°Р в„–Р СР ВµРЎР‚
            if (mc.level.getGameTime() % 20 == 0) {
                ClientData.voteTimer--;
            }
        }

        // 1. Р С›РЎвЂљР Т‘Р В°РЎвЂЎР В° (Recoil)
        RecoilHandler.clientTick();


        // 3. Р вЂєР С›Р вЂњР ВР С™Р С’ Р РЋР СћР В Р вЂўР вЂєР В¬Р вЂР В« Р ВР вЂ” Р СћР вЂўР ТђР СњР ВР С™Р В
        Entity vehicle = mc.player.getVehicle();
        if (vehicle instanceof M2BrowningEntity || vehicle instanceof AGS30Entity) {
            long windowId = mc.getWindow().getWindow();
            boolean isLeftBtnDown = GLFW.glfwGetMouseButton(windowId, GLFW.GLFW_MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT) == GLFW.GLFW_PRESS;

            if (isLeftBtnDown && mc.screen == null) {
                PacketHandler.INSTANCE.sendToServer(new PacketVehicleShoot());
                while (mc.options.keyAttack.consumeClick()) { }
            }
        }
        // Р вЂќР С•Р В±Р В°Р Р†Р В»РЎРЏР ВµР С Р С—РЎР‚Р С•Р Р†Р ВµРЎР‚Р С”РЎС“ mc.player.isAlive()
        if (mc.player.getPersistentData().getBoolean("AAS_IsDowned") && mc.player.isAlive()) {
            mc.player.setDeltaMovement(0, mc.player.getDeltaMovement().y, 0);

            if (mc.screen == null) {
                mc.setScreen(new DownedScreen());
            }
        } else {
            if (mc.player.getPersistentData().contains("AAS_DownedYaw")) {
                mc.player.getPersistentData().remove("AAS_DownedYaw");
                mc.player.getPersistentData().remove("AAS_DownedPitch");
            }
        }
        handleReviveHold(mc);

        // Р С›Р В±Р Р…Р С•Р Р†Р В»РЎРЏР ВµР С РЎвЂ Р ВµР В»РЎРЉ Р Т‘Р В»РЎРЏ Р Р†Р С‘Р В·РЎС“Р В°Р В»РЎРЉР Р…Р С•Р в„– Р С—Р С•Р Т‘РЎРѓР С”Р В°Р В·Р С”Р С‘ "Р В·Р В°Р В¶Р СР С‘РЎвЂљР Вµ F" (Р Р…Р В°Р Р†Р С•Р Т‘Р С”Р В° + Р Р…РЎС“Р В¶Р Р…РЎвЂ№Р в„– Р С—РЎР‚Р ВµР Т‘Р СР ВµРЎвЂљ Р Р† РЎР‚РЎС“Р С”Р Вµ)
        currentRevivePromptTarget = findRevivePromptTarget(mc);
        // ==== РџРѕРґСЃРєР°Р·РєРё РґР»СЏ РЅРѕРІРёС‡РєРѕРІ ====
        if (hintCheckDelay > 0) {
            hintCheckDelay--;
        } else {
            checkOnboardingHints(mc);
        }
    }



    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onMovementInput(net.minecraftforge.client.event.MovementInputUpdateEvent event) {
        Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
        if (mc.player == null) return;

        if (mc.player.getPersistentData().getBoolean("AAS_IsDraggingAlly")) {
            if (event.getInput().forwardImpulse > 0) {
                event.getInput().forwardImpulse = 0f;
            }
            // Р СџРЎР‚Р С‘ Р В¶Р ВµР В»Р В°Р Р…Р С‘Р С‘ Р СР С•Р В¶Р Р…Р С• Р С•Р С–РЎР‚Р В°Р Р…Р С‘РЎвЂЎР С‘РЎвЂљРЎРЉ Р С‘ РЎР‚РЎвЂ№Р Р†Р С”Р С‘ Р Р† РЎРѓРЎвЂљР С•РЎР‚Р С•Р Р…РЎвЂ№:
            // event.getInput().leftImpulse *= 0.5f;
        }
    }

    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onMouseScroll(InputEvent.MouseScrollingEvent event) {
        Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
        // Р вЂўРЎРѓР В»Р С‘ Р С”Р В°РЎР‚РЎвЂљР В° Р С•РЎвЂљР С”РЎР‚РЎвЂ№РЎвЂљР В° (Р Р…Р В° TAB)
        if (ClientData.isMapOpen && mc.screen == null) {
            double delta = event.getScrollDelta();
            if (delta != 0) {
                // Р вЂ™РЎвЂ№Р В·РЎвЂ№Р Р†Р В°Р ВµР С РЎвЂљР С•РЎвЂљ Р В¶Р Вµ РЎРѓР В°Р СРЎвЂ№Р в„– Р В±Р ВµР В·Р С•Р С—Р В°РЎРѓР Р…РЎвЂ№Р в„– Р В·РЎС“Р С
                ClientData.zoomMap(delta);
                event.setCanceled(true);
            }
        }
    }
    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onRenderLevel(RenderLevelStageEvent event) {
        if (event.getStage() != RenderLevelStageEvent.Stage.AFTER_PARTICLES) return;

        Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
        if (mc.player == null || mc.level == null) return;

        // Р СљР В°РЎР‚Р С”Р ВµРЎР‚ "Р В·Р В°Р В¶Р СР С‘РЎвЂљР Вµ F" РЎР‚Р С‘РЎРѓРЎС“Р ВµР С Р Р…Р ВµР В·Р В°Р Р†Р С‘РЎРѓР С‘Р СР С• Р С•РЎвЂљ Р Р…Р В°Р В»Р С‘РЎвЂЎР С‘РЎРЏ Р С•РЎвЂљРЎР‚РЎРЏР Т‘Р В° (Р С—Р С•РЎРЊРЎвЂљР С•Р СРЎС“ Р Т‘Р С• Р Р†РЎвЂ№РЎвЂ¦Р С•Р Т‘Р В° Р Р…Р С‘Р В¶Р Вµ)
        if (currentRevivePromptTarget != null && currentRevivePromptTarget.isAlive()) {
            renderRevivePrompt(event.getPoseStack(), event.getCamera().getPosition(), currentRevivePromptTarget, mc, event.getPartialTick());
        }

        String myName = mc.player.getScoreboardName();
        com.example.aas.world.AASWorldData.Squad mySquad = null;

        for (com.example.aas.world.AASWorldData.Squad s : com.example.aas.client.ClientData.clientSquads) {
            if (s.members.contains(myName)) {
                mySquad = s;
                break;
            }
        }

        if (mySquad == null) return;

        // Р С›Р С—РЎР‚Р ВµР Т‘Р ВµР В»РЎРЏР ВµР С РЎР‚Р С•Р В»РЎРЉ Р С‘Р С–РЎР‚Р С•Р С”Р В°
        boolean isSL = mySquad.leader.equals(myName);
        boolean isBravo = mySquad.bravoMembers.contains(myName) || mySquad.bravoLeader.equals(myName);
        boolean isCharlie = mySquad.charlieMembers.contains(myName) || mySquad.charlieLeader.equals(myName);

        PoseStack poseStack = event.getPoseStack();
        Vec3 cameraPos = event.getCamera().getPosition();
        long gameTime = mc.level.getGameTime();
        float blinkAlpha = 0.45f + (float)Math.sin(gameTime * 0.4f) * 0.25f;

        // --- 1. Р СџР ВР СњР вЂњР В (Р вЂњР вЂєР С’Р вЂ”Р С’) ---
        // Р СџР С‘Р Р…Р С– Р В»Р С‘Р Т‘Р ВµРЎР‚Р В° Р Р†Р С‘Р Т‘РЎРЏРЎвЂљ Р вЂ™Р РЋР вЂў Р Р† Р С•РЎвЂљРЎР‚РЎРЏР Т‘Р Вµ
        if (mySquad.pingPos != null && gameTime < mySquad.pingExpiry) {
            render3DMarker(poseStack, cameraPos, mySquad.pingPos, PING_TEXTURE, mc, blinkAlpha, 0.5);
        }
        // Р СџР С‘Р Р…Р С–Р С‘ Bravo/Charlie РЎвЂљР ВµР С—Р ВµРЎР‚РЎРЉ Р Р†Р С‘Р Т‘Р С‘РЎвЂљ Р Р†Р ВµРЎРѓРЎРЉ Р С•РЎвЂљРЎР‚РЎРЏР Т‘, Р В° Р Р…Р Вµ РЎвЂљР С•Р В»РЎРЉР С”Р С• Р РЋР вЂє Р С‘ РЎС“РЎвЂЎР В°РЎРѓРЎвЂљР Р…Р С‘Р С”Р С•Р Р† РЎРѓР С•Р С•РЎвЂљР Р†Р ВµРЎвЂљРЎРѓРЎвЂљР Р†РЎС“РЎР‹РЎвЂ°Р ВµР С–Р С• РЎвЂћР В°Р ВµРЎР‚РЎвЂљР С‘Р СР В°
        if (mySquad.bravoPingPos != null && gameTime < mySquad.bravoPingExpiry) {
            render3DMarker(poseStack, cameraPos, mySquad.bravoPingPos, PING_TEX_BRAVO, mc, blinkAlpha, 0.5);
        }
        if (mySquad.charliePingPos != null && gameTime < mySquad.charliePingExpiry) {
            render3DMarker(poseStack, cameraPos, mySquad.charliePingPos, PING_TEX_CHARLIE, mc, blinkAlpha, 0.5);
        }

        // --- 2. Р СљР вЂўР СћР С™Р В Р вЂќР вЂ™Р ВР вЂ“Р вЂўР СњР ВР Р‡ (MOVE - Р СћР ВР Сџ 0) ---
        // Р СљРЎвЂ№ РЎР‚Р С‘РЎРѓРЎС“Р ВµР С РЎвЂћР С‘Р В·Р С‘РЎвЂЎР ВµРЎРѓР С”РЎС“РЎР‹ Р СР ВµРЎвЂљР С”РЎС“ Р Р† Р СР С‘РЎР‚Р Вµ Р СћР С›Р вЂєР В¬Р С™Р С› Р ВµРЎРѓР В»Р С‘ Р ВµРЎвЂ РЎвЂљР С‘Р С— == 0 (Move)

        // Р СљР ВµРЎвЂљР С”Р В° Р В»Р С‘Р Т‘Р ВµРЎР‚Р В° (Р Р†Р С‘Р Т‘РЎРЏРЎвЂљ Р Р†РЎРѓР Вµ)
        if (mySquad.marker != null && mySquad.marker.type == 0 && gameTime < mySquad.marker.expiryTick) {
            BlockPos mPos = new BlockPos(mySquad.marker.x, mySquad.marker.y, mySquad.marker.z);
            render3DMarker(poseStack, cameraPos, mPos, MOVE_TEXTURE, mc, 1.0f, 0.5);
        }

        // Р СљР ВµРЎвЂљР С”Р В° Bravo (SL + Bravo)
        if (mySquad.bravoMarker != null && mySquad.bravoMarker.type == 0 && gameTime < mySquad.bravoMarker.expiryTick) {
            BlockPos mPos = new BlockPos(mySquad.bravoMarker.x, mySquad.bravoMarker.y, mySquad.bravoMarker.z);
            render3DMarker(poseStack, cameraPos, mPos, MOVE_TEX_BRAVO, mc, 1.0f, 0.5);
        }

        // Р СљР ВµРЎвЂљР С”Р В° Charlie (SL + Charlie)
        if (mySquad.charlieMarker != null && mySquad.charlieMarker.type == 0 && gameTime < mySquad.charlieMarker.expiryTick) {
            BlockPos mPos = new BlockPos(mySquad.charlieMarker.x, mySquad.charlieMarker.y, mySquad.charlieMarker.z);
            render3DMarker(poseStack, cameraPos, mPos, MOVE_TEX_CHARLIE, mc, 1.0f, 0.5);
        }
        // --- Attack / Defend / Build РґР»СЏ Р»РёРґРµСЂР° РѕС‚СЂСЏРґР° ---
        if (mySquad.marker != null && gameTime < mySquad.marker.expiryTick) {
            BlockPos mPos = new BlockPos(mySquad.marker.x, mySquad.marker.y, mySquad.marker.z);
            ResourceLocation tex = radialMarkerTexture(mySquad.marker.type);
            if (tex != null) render3DMarker(poseStack, cameraPos, mPos, tex, mc, 1.0f, 0.5);
        }
// --- Attack / Defend / Build РґР»СЏ Bravo FTL ---
        if (mySquad.bravoMarker != null && gameTime < mySquad.bravoMarker.expiryTick) {
            BlockPos mPos = new BlockPos(mySquad.bravoMarker.x, mySquad.bravoMarker.y, mySquad.bravoMarker.z);
            ResourceLocation tex = radialMarkerTexture(mySquad.bravoMarker.type);
            if (tex != null) render3DMarker(poseStack, cameraPos, mPos, tex, mc, 1.0f, 0.5);
        }
// --- Attack / Defend / Build РґР»СЏ Charlie FTL ---
        if (mySquad.charlieMarker != null && gameTime < mySquad.charlieMarker.expiryTick) {
            BlockPos mPos = new BlockPos(mySquad.charlieMarker.x, mySquad.charlieMarker.y, mySquad.charlieMarker.z);
            ResourceLocation tex = radialMarkerTexture(mySquad.charlieMarker.type);
            if (tex != null) render3DMarker(poseStack, cameraPos, mPos, tex, mc, 1.0f, 0.5);
        }
    }

    /** type 0 (Move) СѓР¶Рµ РѕС‚СЂРёСЃРѕРІР°РЅ РѕС‚РґРµР»СЊРЅС‹Рј Р±Р»РѕРєРѕРј РІС‹С€Рµ вЂ” С‚СѓС‚ С‚РѕР»СЊРєРѕ 1/2/3. */
    private static ResourceLocation radialMarkerTexture(int type) {
        switch (type) {
            case 1: return MARKER_ATTACK_3D;
            case 2: return MARKER_DEFEND_3D;
            case 3: return MARKER_BUILD_3D;
            default: return null;
        }
    }

    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onRenderOverlayPre(RenderGuiOverlayEvent.Pre event) {
        Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
        if (mc.player == null) return;

        // Р вЂўРЎРѓР В»Р С‘ Р С—РЎР‚Р С‘РЎвЂ Р ВµР В» (Crosshair) Р С–Р С•РЎвЂљР С•Р Р†Р С‘РЎвЂљРЎРѓРЎРЏ Р С” РЎР‚Р ВµР Р…Р Т‘Р ВµРЎР‚РЎС“
        if (event.getOverlay() == net.minecraftforge.client.gui.overlay.VanillaGuiOverlay.CROSSHAIR.type()) {
            boolean usingBinoculars = mc.player.isUsingItem() && mc.player.getUseItem().getItem() == ModItems.BINOCULARS.get();
            Entity vehicle = mc.player.getVehicle();
            boolean aimingInVehicle = (vehicle instanceof AGS30Entity ags && ags.isAiming()) ||
                    (vehicle instanceof M2BrowningEntity m2 && m2.isAiming());

            if (usingBinoculars || aimingInVehicle) {
                event.setCanceled(true);
            }
        }

        // Р СњР С›Р вЂ™Р С›Р вЂў: РЎРѓР С”РЎР‚РЎвЂ№Р Р†Р В°Р ВµР С Р Р†Р В°Р Р…Р С‘Р В»РЎРЉР Р…РЎвЂ№Р в„– РЎРѓР С—Р С‘РЎРѓР С•Р С” Р С‘Р С–РЎР‚Р С•Р С”Р С•Р Р† (TAB) Р С—Р С•Р С”Р В° Р СР В°РЎвЂљРЎвЂЎ Р С‘Р Т‘РЎвЂРЎвЂљ,
        // РЎвЂљ.Р С”. TAB Р В·Р В°Р Р…РЎРЏРЎвЂљ Р С—Р С•Р Т‘ Р С•РЎвЂљР С”РЎР‚РЎвЂ№РЎвЂљР С‘Р Вµ Р С”Р В°РЎР‚РЎвЂљРЎвЂ№
        if (event.getOverlay() == net.minecraftforge.client.gui.overlay.VanillaGuiOverlay.PLAYER_LIST.type()) {
            boolean isCreativeOrSpectator = mc.player.isCreative() || mc.player.isSpectator();

            if (ClientData.isGameStarted && !isCreativeOrSpectator) {
                event.setCanceled(true);
            }
        }
    }
    private static boolean tryPlacePingLogic(Minecraft mc) {
        String myName = mc.player.getScoreboardName();
        boolean canPing = false;

        // Р СџРЎР‚Р С•Р Р†Р ВµРЎР‚РЎРЏР ВµР С РЎР‚Р С•Р В»РЎРЉ: РЎвЂљР С•Р В»РЎРЉР С”Р С• SL Р С‘Р В»Р С‘ FTL Р СР С•Р С–РЎС“РЎвЂљ РЎРѓРЎвЂљР В°Р Р†Р С‘РЎвЂљРЎРЉ Р СР ВµРЎвЂљР С”РЎС“
        for (com.example.aas.world.AASWorldData.Squad s : com.example.aas.client.ClientData.clientSquads) {
            if (s.leader.equals(myName) || s.bravoLeader.equals(myName) || s.charlieLeader.equals(myName)) {
                canPing = true;
                break;
            }
        }

        if (canPing) {
            boolean isShift = net.minecraft.client.gui.screens.Screen.hasShiftDown();
            PacketHandler.INSTANCE.sendToServer(new PacketPlacePing(isShift));
            mc.player.playSound(ModSounds.MAP_MARKER_PLACE.get(), 1.0f, 1.0f);
            return true; // Р СР ВµРЎвЂљР С”РЎС“ РЎР‚Р ВµР В°Р В»РЎРЉР Р…Р С• Р С—Р С•РЎРѓРЎвЂљР В°Р Р†Р С‘Р В»Р С‘
        }
        return false; // Р Р…Р Вµ Р В±РЎвЂ№Р В»Р С• Р С—РЎР‚Р В°Р Р† РІР‚вЂќ pick-block Р Р…Р Вµ РЎвЂљРЎР‚Р С•Р С–Р В°Р ВµР С
    }
    /**
     * РќР°Р¶Р°С‚РёРµ РєР»Р°РІРёС€Рё/РєРЅРѕРїРєРё СѓСЃС‚Р°РЅРѕРІРєРё РјРµС‚РєРё.
     * Shift Р·Р°Р¶Р°С‚ -> РєР°Рє Рё СЂР°РЅСЊС€Рµ, РјРіРЅРѕРІРµРЅРЅРѕ СЃС‚Р°РІРёРј РјРµС‚РєСѓ РґРІРёР¶РµРЅРёСЏ (РЅРµ С‚СЂРѕРіР°РµРј).
     * Р‘РµР· Shift -> РќР• СЃС‚Р°РІРёРј РјРµС‚РєСѓ СЃСЂР°Р·Сѓ, Р° Р·Р°РїСѓСЃРєР°РµРј С‚Р°Р№РјРµСЂ СѓРґРµСЂР¶Р°РЅРёСЏ:
     *   - РµСЃР»Рё РєР»Р°РІРёС€Р° РѕС‚РїСѓС‰РµРЅР° Р±С‹СЃС‚СЂРѕ (< RADIAL_HOLD_MS) -> РѕР±С‹С‡РЅС‹Р№ "РіР»Р°Р·РёРє" (СЃРј. handleRadialKeyRelease)
     *   - РµСЃР»Рё РєР»Р°РІРёС€Р° СѓРґРµСЂР¶Р°РЅР° РґРѕР»СЊС€Рµ РїРѕСЂРѕРіР° -> РѕС‚РєСЂС‹РІР°РµРј СЂР°РґРёР°Р»СЊРЅРѕРµ РјРµРЅСЋ (СЃРј. onClientTick)
     */
    private static void handleRadialKeyPress(Minecraft mc) {
        if (net.minecraft.client.gui.screens.Screen.hasShiftDown()) {
            // РџРѕРІРµРґРµРЅРёРµ РЅРµ РјРµРЅСЏРµРј: Shift + РєР»Р°РІРёС€Р° = РјРµС‚РєР° РґРІРёР¶РµРЅРёСЏ, РјРіРЅРѕРІРµРЅРЅРѕ
            tryPlacePingLogic(mc);
            return;
        }
        radialKeyHeld = true;
        radialScreenOpened = false;
        radialKeyPressTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
    }

    /**
     * РћС‚РїСѓСЃРєР°РЅРёРµ РєР»Р°РІРёС€Рё/РєРЅРѕРїРєРё СѓСЃС‚Р°РЅРѕРІРєРё РјРµС‚РєРё.
     * Р•СЃР»Рё РјРµРЅСЋ СѓР¶Рµ Р±С‹Р»Рѕ РѕС‚РєСЂС‹С‚Рѕ РїРѕ СѓРґРµСЂР¶Р°РЅРёСЋ вЂ” РїСЂРѕ Р·Р°РєСЂС‹С‚РёРµ/СѓСЃС‚Р°РЅРѕРІРєСѓ РјРµС‚РєРё
     * Р·Р°Р±РѕС‚РёС‚СЃСЏ СЃР°Рј WorldMarkerRadialScreen (РµРіРѕ mouseReleased/keyReleased).
     * Р•СЃР»Рё РјРµРЅСЋ РќР• СѓСЃРїРµР»Рѕ РѕС‚РєСЂС‹С‚СЊСЃСЏ (РєРѕСЂРѕС‚РєРёР№ С‚Р°Рї) вЂ” СЃС‚Р°РІРёРј РѕР±С‹С‡РЅСѓСЋ РјРµС‚РєСѓ-РіР»Р°Р·,
     * РєР°Рє СЌС‚Рѕ Р±С‹Р»Рѕ СЂР°РЅСЊС€Рµ РїСЂРё РѕР±С‹С‡РЅРѕРј РєР»РёРєРµ.
     */
    private static void handleRadialKeyRelease(Minecraft mc) {
        if (!radialKeyHeld) return;
        boolean wasScreenOpened = radialScreenOpened;
        radialKeyHeld = false;
        radialScreenOpened = false;
        if (!wasScreenOpened) {
            tryPlacePingLogic(mc);
        }
    }
    /**
     * Р Р€Р Р…Р С‘Р Р†Р ВµРЎР‚РЎРѓР В°Р В»РЎРЉР Р…РЎвЂ№Р в„– Р Р†РЎРѓР С—Р С•Р СР С•Р С–Р В°РЎвЂљР ВµР В»РЎРЉР Р…РЎвЂ№Р в„– Р СР ВµРЎвЂљР С•Р Т‘ Р Т‘Р В»РЎРЏ Р С•РЎвЂљРЎР‚Р С‘РЎРѓР С•Р Р†Р С”Р С‘ 3D Р СР В°РЎР‚Р С”Р ВµРЎР‚Р В°
     */
    private static void render3DMarker(PoseStack poseStack, Vec3 cameraPos, BlockPos pos, ResourceLocation texture, Minecraft mc, float alpha, double heightOffset) {
        poseStack.pushPose();

        double renderX = pos.getX() + 0.5 - cameraPos.x;
        double renderY = pos.getY() + heightOffset - cameraPos.y;
        double renderZ = pos.getZ() + 0.5 - cameraPos.z;
        poseStack.translate(renderX, renderY, renderZ);

        poseStack.mulPose(mc.getEntityRenderDispatcher().cameraOrientation());

        float scale = 0.025f;
        double distSq = mc.player.distanceToSqr(pos.getX() + 0.5, pos.getY() + 0.5, pos.getZ() + 0.5);
        if (distSq > 100) {
            scale *= (float)(Math.sqrt(distSq) / 10.0);
        }
        scale = Math.min(scale, 0.25f);
        poseStack.scale(-scale, -scale, scale);

        Matrix4f matrix = poseStack.last().pose();

        // Р В Р ВµР Р…Р Т‘Р ВµРЎР‚Р С‘Р С РЎвЂЎР ВµРЎР‚Р ВµР В· Tesselator Р Р…Р В°Р С—РЎР‚РЎРЏР СРЎС“РЎР‹ РІР‚вЂќ disableDepthTest РЎР‚Р В°Р В±Р С•РЎвЂљР В°Р ВµРЎвЂљ Р В·Р Т‘Р ВµРЎРѓРЎРЉ
        com.mojang.blaze3d.systems.RenderSystem.enableBlend();
        com.mojang.blaze3d.systems.RenderSystem.defaultBlendFunc();
        com.mojang.blaze3d.systems.RenderSystem.disableDepthTest();  // РЎвЂљР ВµР С—Р ВµРЎР‚РЎРЉ РЎР‚Р ВµР В°Р В»РЎРЉР Р…Р С• РЎР‚Р В°Р В±Р С•РЎвЂљР В°Р ВµРЎвЂљ
        com.mojang.blaze3d.systems.RenderSystem.setShaderTexture(0, texture);
        com.mojang.blaze3d.systems.RenderSystem.setShader(net.minecraft.client.renderer.GameRenderer::getPositionTexColorShader);

        com.mojang.blaze3d.vertex.Tesselator tesselator = com.mojang.blaze3d.vertex.Tesselator.getInstance();
        com.mojang.blaze3d.vertex.BufferBuilder buf = tesselator.getBuilder();
        buf.begin(com.mojang.blaze3d.vertex.VertexFormat.Mode.QUADS, com.mojang.blaze3d.vertex.DefaultVertexFormat.POSITION_TEX_COLOR);

        int a = (int)(alpha * 255);
        buf.vertex(matrix, -8, -8, 0).uv(0, 0).color(255, 255, 255, a).endVertex();
        buf.vertex(matrix, -8,  8, 0).uv(0, 1).color(255, 255, 255, a).endVertex();
        buf.vertex(matrix,  8,  8, 0).uv(1, 1).color(255, 255, 255, a).endVertex();
        buf.vertex(matrix,  8, -8, 0).uv(1, 0).color(255, 255, 255, a).endVertex();

        tesselator.end();

        com.mojang.blaze3d.systems.RenderSystem.enableDepthTest();
        com.mojang.blaze3d.systems.RenderSystem.setShaderColor(1, 1, 1, 1);

        poseStack.popPose();
    }

    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onMouseInput(InputEvent.MouseButton.Pre event) {
        Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
        if (mc.player == null || mc.level == null) return;
        Entity vehicle = mc.player.getVehicle();

        if (event.getButton() == GLFW.GLFW_MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT) {
            if (vehicle instanceof M2BrowningEntity || vehicle instanceof AGS30Entity) {
                event.setCanceled(true);
            }
        }

        if (ModKeyBindings.PLACE_PING_KEY.matchesMouse(event.getButton())) {
            if (event.getAction() == GLFW.GLFW_PRESS) {
                if (mc.screen == null) {
                    event.setCanceled(true); // РЅРµ РґР°С‘Рј СЃРєРѕРЅС„Р»РёРєС‚РѕРІР°С‚СЊ СЃ Pick Block
                    handleRadialKeyPress(mc);
                }
            } else if (event.getAction() == GLFW.GLFW_RELEASE) {
                handleRadialKeyRelease(mc);
            }
        }
        if (event.getButton() == GLFW.GLFW_MOUSE_BUTTON_RIGHT && event.getAction() == GLFW.GLFW_PRESS) {
            if (vehicle instanceof M2BrowningEntity || vehicle instanceof AGS30Entity) {
                PacketHandler.INSTANCE.sendToServer(new PacketToggleAim());
                event.setCanceled(true);
                return;
            }
        }

        if (event.getButton() == GLFW.GLFW_MOUSE_BUTTON_MIDDLE && event.getAction() == GLFW.GLFW_PRESS) {
            ItemStack stack = mc.player.getMainHandItem();
            if (stack.getItem() instanceof VehicleMarkerItem || stack.getItem() instanceof SupplyTruckMarkerItem) {
                HitResult result = mc.hitResult;
                if (result != null && result.getType() == HitResult.Type.ENTITY) {
                    EntityHitResult entityResult = (EntityHitResult) result;
                    Entity target = entityResult.getEntity();
                    PacketHandler.INSTANCE.sendToServer(new PacketApplyMarker(target.getId()));
                }
            }
        }
    }

    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onComputeFov(ComputeFovModifierEvent event) {
        Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
        if (mc.player != null) {
            // Р вЂ”РЎС“Р С Р Т‘Р В»РЎРЏ Р В±Р С‘Р Р…Р С•Р С”Р В»РЎРЏ
            ItemStack activeStack = mc.player.getUseItem();
            if (activeStack.getItem() == ModItems.BINOCULARS.get()) {
                event.setNewFovModifier(event.getFovModifier() * (1.0f / 8.0f));
            }

            // Р вЂ™Р В°РЎв‚¬Р В° РЎРѓРЎС“РЎвЂ°Р ВµРЎРѓРЎвЂљР Р†РЎС“РЎР‹РЎвЂ°Р В°РЎРЏ Р В»Р С•Р С–Р С‘Р С”Р В° Р Т‘Р В»РЎРЏ РЎвЂљР ВµРЎвЂ¦Р Р…Р С‘Р С”Р С‘...
            Entity vehicle = mc.player.getVehicle();
            if (vehicle instanceof M2BrowningEntity m2 && m2.isAiming()) {
                event.setNewFovModifier(event.getFovModifier() * (1.0f / 1.5f));
            } else if (vehicle instanceof AGS30Entity ags && ags.isAiming()) {
                event.setNewFovModifier(event.getFovModifier() * (1.0f / 3f));
            }
        }
    }

    private static final ResourceLocation BINOCULAR_SHADER = new ResourceLocation("aas", "shaders/post/binoculars.json");
    private static boolean wasUsingBinoculars = false;

    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onClientTickShader(TickEvent.ClientTickEvent event) {
        if (event.phase != TickEvent.Phase.END) return;
        Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
        if (mc.player == null) return;

        boolean isUsingBinoculars = mc.player.isUsingItem() && mc.player.getUseItem().getItem() == ModItems.BINOCULARS.get();

        if (isUsingBinoculars && !wasUsingBinoculars) {
            System.out.println("DEBUG: Loading Binocular Shader"); // Р СћР вЂўР РЋР Сћ
            mc.tell(() -> mc.gameRenderer.loadEffect(BINOCULAR_SHADER));
            wasUsingBinoculars = true;
        } else if (!isUsingBinoculars && wasUsingBinoculars) {
            System.out.println("DEBUG: Shutting down Shader"); // Р СћР вЂўР РЋР Сћ
            mc.tell(() -> mc.gameRenderer.shutdownEffect());
            wasUsingBinoculars = false;
        }
    }


    // Р вЂ™ РЎвЂћР В°Р в„–Р В»Р Вµ ClientEvents.java Р Р…Р В°Р в„–Р Т‘Р С‘РЎвЂљР Вµ Р СР ВµРЎвЂљР С•Р Т‘ onOpenGui
    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onOpenGui(ScreenEvent.Opening event) {
        if (event.getScreen() instanceof DeathScreen && !(event.getScreen() instanceof AASDeathScreen)) {
            // Р вЂўРЎРѓР В»Р С‘ Р С‘Р С–РЎР‚Р С•Р С” РЎС“Р СР ВµРЎР‚, Р Р…Р С• РЎвЂљР В°Р в„–Р СР ВµРЎР‚ РЎС“Р В¶Р Вµ Р В·Р В°Р С—РЎС“РЎвЂ°Р ВµР Р… (Р В±РЎвЂ№Р В» Р Р† Р Р…Р С•Р С”Р В°РЎС“РЎвЂљР Вµ), Р СњР вЂў Р СџР вЂўР В Р вЂўР вЂ”Р С’Р СџР ВР РЋР В«Р вЂ™Р С’Р вЂўР Сљ
            if (ClientData.globalDeathTimestamp == 0) {
                ClientData.globalDeathTimestamp = System.currentTimeMillis();
            }

            ClientData.deathFadeStartTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
            ClientData.deathFadePlayed = true;

            Component cause = null;
            if (Minecraft.getInstance().player != null) {
                cause = Minecraft.getInstance().player.getCombatTracker().getDeathMessage();
            }
            event.setNewScreen(new AASDeathScreen(cause, false));
        }
    }

    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onKeyInput(InputEvent.Key event) {
        Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
        if (mc.player == null) return;

        // --- Р¤РРљРЎ: F РѕРґРЅРѕРІСЂРµРјРµРЅРЅРѕ С‚СЂРёРіРіРµСЂРёС‚ СЂРµРІР°Р№РІ Рё РІР°РЅРёР»СЊРЅС‹Р№ Swap Offhand ---
        // Р­С‚Рѕ СЃРѕР±С‹С‚РёРµ РїСЂРёС…РѕРґРёС‚ РЎР РђР—РЈ РїРѕСЃР»Рµ KeyMapping.click(), РЅРѕ Р”Рћ С‚РѕРіРѕ РєР°Рє
        // Minecraft.handleKeybinds() (РІС‹Р·С‹РІР°РµС‚СЃСЏ РєР°Р¶РґС‹Р№ РєР°РґСЂ, Р° РЅРµ РєР°Р¶РґС‹Р№ С‚РёРє)
        // СѓСЃРїРµРµС‚ РІС‹Р·РІР°С‚СЊ keySwapOffhand.consumeClick() Рё РѕС‚РїСЂР°РІРёС‚СЊ СЃРІР°Рї РЅР° СЃРµСЂРІРµСЂ.
        // РџРѕСЌС‚РѕРјСѓ СЃСЉРµРґР°РµРј РєР»РёРє Р·РґРµСЃСЊ, Р° РЅРµ РІ TickEvent вЂ” С‚Р°Рј СѓР¶Рµ РјРѕР¶РµС‚ Р±С‹С‚СЊ РїРѕР·РґРЅРѕ,
        // С‚.Рє. С‚РёРє РёРґС‘С‚ СЂРµР¶Рµ РєР°РґСЂРѕРІ Рё РІР°РЅРёР»СЊРЅС‹Р№ СЃРІР°Рї СѓСЃРїРµРІР°РµС‚ РїСЂРѕСЃРєРѕС‡РёС‚СЊ СЂР°РЅСЊС€Рµ.
        if (mc.options.keySwapOffhand.matches(event.getKey(), event.getScanCode())
                && mc.screen == null
                && mc.player.isAlive()
                && !mc.player.getPersistentData().getBoolean("AAS_IsDowned")
                && findNearestDownedAlly(mc) != null) {
            while (mc.options.keySwapOffhand.consumeClick()) { }
        }

        if (event.getKey() == GLFW.GLFW_KEY_PAGE_UP && event.getAction() == GLFW.GLFW_PRESS) {
            PacketHandler.INSTANCE.sendToServer(new PacketConfirmArtStrike(true));
        }
        if (event.getKey() == GLFW.GLFW_KEY_PAGE_DOWN && event.getAction() == GLFW.GLFW_PRESS) {
            PacketHandler.INSTANCE.sendToServer(new PacketConfirmArtStrike(false));
        }
        // --- Р вЂєР С›Р вЂњР ВР С™Р С’ Р вЂњР С›Р вЂєР С›Р РЋР С›Р вЂ™Р С’Р СњР ВР Р‡ Р вЂ”Р С’ CMD (F7/F8) ---
        String myTeam = mc.player.getTeam() != null ? mc.player.getTeam().getName().toUpperCase() : "NEUTRAL";
        boolean isBlue = myTeam.equals("BLUE");

        // Р СџРЎР‚Р С•Р Р†Р ВµРЎР‚РЎРЏР ВµР С РЎРѓРЎвЂљР В°РЎвЂљРЎС“РЎРѓ Р С–Р С•Р В»Р С•РЎРѓР С•Р Р†Р В°Р Р…Р С‘РЎРЏ Р С‘Р СР ВµР Р…Р Р…Р С• Р Т‘Р В»РЎРЏ Р РЋР вЂ™Р С›Р вЂўР в„ў Р С”Р С•Р СР В°Р Р…Р Т‘РЎвЂ№
        boolean myTeamCmdActive = isBlue ? ClientData.blueCmdVoteActive : ClientData.redCmdVoteActive;
        String myCandidateName = isBlue ? ClientData.blueCmdCandidateName : ClientData.redCmdCandidateName;

        if (myTeamCmdActive && mc.screen == null) {
            // Р С™Р В°Р Р…Р Т‘Р С‘Р Т‘Р В°РЎвЂљ Р Р…Р Вµ Р СР С•Р В¶Р ВµРЎвЂљ Р С–Р С•Р В»Р С•РЎРѓР С•Р Р†Р В°РЎвЂљРЎРЉ Р В·Р В° РЎРѓР В°Р СР С•Р С–Р С• РЎРѓР ВµР В±РЎРЏ
            boolean isCandidate = mc.player.getScoreboardName().equals(myCandidateName);

            if (!isCandidate) {
                if (event.getKey() == GLFW.GLFW_KEY_F7 && event.getAction() == GLFW.GLFW_PRESS) {
                    PacketHandler.INSTANCE.sendToServer(new PacketCMDVote(true));
                    mc.player.displayClientMessage(Component.literal("Voted: YES").withStyle(ChatFormatting.GREEN), true);
                    return;
                } else if (event.getKey() == GLFW.GLFW_KEY_F8 && event.getAction() == GLFW.GLFW_PRESS) {
                    PacketHandler.INSTANCE.sendToServer(new PacketCMDVote(false));
                    mc.player.displayClientMessage(Component.literal("Voted: NO").withStyle(ChatFormatting.RED), true);
                    return;
                }
            }
        }
        if (ModKeyBindings.PLACE_PING_KEY.matches(event.getKey(), event.getScanCode())) {
            if (event.getAction() == GLFW.GLFW_PRESS) {
                if (mc.screen == null) {
                    handleRadialKeyPress(mc);
                }
            } else if (event.getAction() == GLFW.GLFW_RELEASE) {
                handleRadialKeyRelease(mc);
            }
            return;
        }
        // 1. Р вЂєР С›Р вЂњР ВР С™Р С’ Р вЂњР С›Р вЂєР С›Р РЋР С›Р вЂ™Р С’Р СњР ВР Р‡ (F1/F2)
        if (ClientData.voteActive && mc.screen == null && event.getAction() == GLFW.GLFW_PRESS) {
            if (event.getKey() == GLFW.GLFW_KEY_F9) {
                PacketHandler.INSTANCE.sendToServer(new PacketVoteAction(true));
                // event.setCanceled(true); // Р Р€Р вЂќР С’Р вЂєР вЂўР СњР С›, РЎвЂљР В°Р С” Р С”Р В°Р С” Р Р†РЎвЂ№Р В·РЎвЂ№Р Р†Р В°Р ВµРЎвЂљ Р С”РЎР‚Р В°РЎв‚¬
                return;
            } else if (event.getKey() == GLFW.GLFW_KEY_F10) {
                PacketHandler.INSTANCE.sendToServer(new PacketVoteAction(false));
                // event.setCanceled(true); // Р Р€Р вЂќР С’Р вЂєР вЂўР СњР С›, РЎвЂљР В°Р С” Р С”Р В°Р С” Р Р†РЎвЂ№Р В·РЎвЂ№Р Р†Р В°Р ВµРЎвЂљ Р С”РЎР‚Р В°РЎв‚¬
                return;
            }
        }

        // 2. Р РЋР вЂР В Р С›Р РЋ Р Р‡Р В©Р ВР С™Р С’ (X)
        if (event.getAction() == GLFW.GLFW_PRESS && ModKeyBindings.DROP_SUPPLY_KEY.matches(event.getKey(), event.getScanCode())) {
            if (mc.player.getVehicle() != null) {
                PacketHandler.INSTANCE.sendToServer(new PacketDropCrate());
            }
        }

        // 3. Р СљР вЂўР СњР В® Р С›Р СћР В Р Р‡Р вЂќР С›Р вЂ™ (K)
        if (event.getAction() == GLFW.GLFW_PRESS && ModKeyBindings.OPEN_SQUAD_MENU_KEY.matches(event.getKey(), event.getScanCode())) {
            // Р В Р С’Р вЂ”Р В Р вЂўР РЃР С’Р вЂўР Сљ Р С•РЎвЂљР С”РЎР‚РЎвЂ№РЎвЂљР С‘Р Вµ, Р ВµРЎРѓР В»Р С‘ РЎРЊР С”РЎР‚Р В°Р Р… Р С—РЎС“РЎРѓРЎвЂљР С•Р в„– Р ВР вЂєР В Р ВµРЎРѓР В»Р С‘ Р С•РЎвЂљР С”РЎР‚РЎвЂ№РЎвЂљ РЎРЊР С”РЎР‚Р В°Р Р… Р Р…Р С•Р С”Р В°
            if (mc.screen == null || mc.screen instanceof com.example.aas.client.gui.DownedScreen) {
                String teamName = (mc.player.getTeam() != null) ? mc.player.getTeam().getName() : "";
                boolean isValidTeam = teamName.equalsIgnoreCase("Blue") || teamName.equalsIgnoreCase("Red");

                if (!isValidTeam) {
                    mc.setScreen(new TeamSelectionScreen());
                } else {
                    mc.setScreen(new SquadSelectionScreen());
                }
            }
        }

        // 4. Р С™Р С’Р В Р СћР С’ (TAB)
        if (ModKeyBindings.SHOW_MAP_KEY.matches(event.getKey(), event.getScanCode())) {
            if (event.getAction() == GLFW.GLFW_PRESS) {
                ClientData.isMapOpen = true;
            }
            else if (event.getAction() == GLFW.GLFW_RELEASE) {
                ClientData.isMapOpen = false;
            }
        }
        if (event.getKey() == GLFW.GLFW_KEY_F9 && event.getAction() == GLFW.GLFW_PRESS) {
            if (mc.player.isCreative() && mc.screen == null) {
                PacketHandler.INSTANCE.sendToServer(new PacketDebugFill());
                return;
            }
        }
        // 5. Р РЋР СћР С’Р СћР ВР РЋР СћР ВР С™Р С’ (Caps Lock, Р С—Р ВµРЎР‚Р ВµР В±Р С‘Р Р…Р Т‘Р С‘РЎвЂљРЎРѓРЎРЏ Р Р† Р Р…Р В°РЎРѓРЎвЂљРЎР‚Р С•Р в„–Р С”Р В°РЎвЂ¦ РЎС“Р С—РЎР‚Р В°Р Р†Р В»Р ВµР Р…Р С‘РЎРЏ)
        if (event.getAction() == GLFW.GLFW_PRESS && ModKeyBindings.OPEN_STATS_KEY.matches(event.getKey(), event.getScanCode())) {
            if (mc.screen == null) {
                mc.setScreen(new com.example.aas.client.gui.StatisticsScreen());
            } else if (mc.screen instanceof com.example.aas.client.gui.StatisticsScreen) {
                mc.setScreen(null); // Р С—Р С•Р Р†РЎвЂљР С•РЎР‚Р Р…Р С•Р Вµ Р Р…Р В°Р В¶Р В°РЎвЂљР С‘Р Вµ Р В·Р В°Р С”РЎР‚РЎвЂ№Р Р†Р В°Р ВµРЎвЂљ РЎРЊР С”РЎР‚Р В°Р Р…
            }
        }
    }

    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onGuiOpen(net.minecraftforge.client.event.ScreenEvent.Opening event) {
        Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
        if (mc.player == null) return;

        if (com.example.aas.config.AASConfig.PREVENT_VEHICLE_INVENTORY_ACCESS.get() &&
                !mc.player.isCreative() && mc.player.getVehicle() != null) {

            if (event.getScreen() instanceof net.minecraft.client.gui.screens.inventory.InventoryScreen ||
                    event.getScreen() instanceof net.minecraft.client.gui.screens.inventory.AbstractContainerScreen) {

                event.setCanceled(true);
                mc.player.displayClientMessage(Component.literal("Inventory is disabled while inside a vehicle!")
                        .withStyle(ChatFormatting.RED), true);
            }
        }
    }
    private static float downedCameraProgress = 0f;
    private static float initialPitchOnFall = 0f; // Р В¤Р С‘Р С”РЎРѓР С‘РЎР‚РЎС“Р ВµР С Р Р†Р В·Р С–Р В»РЎРЏР Т‘ Р Р† Р СР С•Р СР ВµР Р…РЎвЂљ РЎС“Р Т‘Р В°РЎР‚Р В°
    private static boolean wasDownedLastFrame = false;

    @SubscribeEvent(priority = EventPriority.HIGHEST)
    public static void onComputeCameraAngles(ViewportEvent.ComputeCameraAngles event) {
        Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
        if (mc.player == null) return;

        boolean isDowned = mc.player.getPersistentData().getBoolean("AAS_IsDowned") && mc.player.isAlive();

        // 1. Р вЂєР С•Р С–Р С‘Р С”Р В° Р Р†РЎвЂ¦Р С•Р Т‘Р В° Р Р† РЎРѓР С•РЎРѓРЎвЂљР С•РЎРЏР Р…Р С‘Р Вµ (РЎвЂћР С‘Р С”РЎРѓР В°РЎвЂ Р С‘РЎРЏ Р Р…Р В°РЎвЂЎР В°Р В»РЎРЉР Р…Р С•Р в„– РЎвЂљР С•РЎвЂЎР С”Р С‘)
        if (isDowned) {
            if (!wasDownedLastFrame) {
                initialPitchOnFall = event.getPitch(); // Р вЂ”Р В°Р С—Р С•Р СР С‘Р Р…Р В°Р ВµР С Р С”РЎС“Р Т‘Р В° РЎРѓР СР С•РЎвЂљРЎР‚Р ВµР В»Р С‘
                wasDownedLastFrame = true;
            }
            if (downedCameraProgress < 1.0f) downedCameraProgress += 0.07f; // Р РЋР С”Р С•РЎР‚Р С•РЎРѓРЎвЂљРЎРЉ "Р С—Р В°Р Т‘Р ВµР Р…Р С‘РЎРЏ"
        } else {
            wasDownedLastFrame = false;
            if (downedCameraProgress > 0.0f) downedCameraProgress -= 0.05f;
        }

        if (downedCameraProgress > 0) {
            float p = downedCameraProgress;

            // 2. Р В­Р В¤Р В¤Р вЂўР С™Р Сћ "Р В Р Р€Р ТђР СњР Р€Р вЂ™Р РЃР вЂўР вЂњР С› Р СћР вЂўР вЂєР С’"
            // Р РЋР Р…Р В°РЎвЂЎР В°Р В»Р В° (Р С—Р ВµРЎР‚Р Р†РЎвЂ№Р Вµ 30% Р С—Р В°Р Т‘Р ВµР Р…Р С‘РЎРЏ) Р С—Р ВµРЎР‚РЎРѓР С•Р Р…Р В°Р В¶ Р Р…Р ВµР СР Р…Р С•Р С–Р С• "Р С”Р В»РЎР‹Р ВµРЎвЂљ" Р Р†Р Р…Р С‘Р В· (stumble)
            float stumble = 0;
            if (p < 0.4f) {
                stumble = Mth.sin(p * (float)Math.PI * 2.5f) * 12f;
            }

            // Р С›РЎРѓР Р…Р С•Р Р†Р Р…Р С•Р в„– Р С—Р ВµРЎР‚Р ВµРЎвЂ¦Р С•Р Т‘ Р С” -60 Р С–РЎР‚Р В°Р Т‘РЎС“РЎРѓР В°Р С
            float targetPitch = -60.0f;
            float smoothPitch = Mth.lerp(p, initialPitchOnFall, targetPitch) + stumble;
            event.setPitch(smoothPitch);

            // 3. Р СњР С’Р С™Р вЂєР С›Р Сњ Р вЂњР С›Р вЂєР С›Р вЂ™Р В« (Roll)
            // Р СџРЎР‚Р С‘ Р С—Р В°Р Т‘Р ВµР Р…Р С‘Р С‘ Р С–Р С•Р В»Р С•Р Р†Р В° Р В·Р В°Р Р†Р В°Р В»Р С‘Р Р†Р В°Р ВµРЎвЂљРЎРѓРЎРЏ Р Р…Р В° Р В±Р С•Р С” Р Р…Р В° 35 Р С–РЎР‚Р В°Р Т‘РЎС“РЎРѓР С•Р Р†
            event.setRoll(p * 35f);

            // 4. Р вЂќР ВР СњР С’Р СљР ВР В§Р вЂўР РЋР С™Р С’Р Р‡ Р СћР В Р Р‡Р РЋР С™Р С’
            // Р вЂ™ Р СР С•Р СР ВµР Р…РЎвЂљ "Р С—РЎР‚Р С‘Р В·Р ВµР СР В»Р ВµР Р…Р С‘РЎРЏ" (Р С”Р С•Р С–Р Т‘Р В° p > 0.8) Р Т‘Р С•Р В±Р В°Р Р†Р В»РЎРЏР ВµР С Р В»Р ВµР С–Р С”Р С‘Р в„– РЎС“Р Т‘Р В°РЎР‚
            if (isDowned && p > 0.8f) {
                float force = (p - 0.8f) * 10f;
                event.setYaw(event.getYaw() + (mc.level.random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * force);
                event.setPitch(event.getPitch() + (mc.level.random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * force);
            }

            // 5. Р ВР СљР ВР СћР С’Р В¦Р ВР Р‡ Р вЂќР В«Р ТђР С’Р СњР ВР Р‡ (Р С”Р С•Р С–Р Т‘Р В° РЎС“Р В¶Р Вµ Р В»Р ВµР В¶Р С‘РЎвЂљ)
            if (p >= 1.0f && isDowned) {
                float breathing = Mth.sin(mc.level.getGameTime() * 0.06f) * 1.5f;
                event.setPitch(targetPitch + breathing);
            }
        }

    }
    private static void handleReviveHold(Minecraft mc) {
        if (mc.level == null || mc.player == null) return;

        // РџСЂРѕРІРµСЂСЏРµРј, Р·Р°Р¶Р°С‚Р° Р»Рё РєР»Р°РІРёС€Р° РїРѕРґСЉС‘РјР° (РїРѕ СѓРјРѕР»С‡Р°РЅРёСЋ F)
        boolean keyDown = ModKeyBindings.REVIVE_KEY.isDown();

        // РЈСЃР»РѕРІРёСЏ: РєРЅРѕРїРєР° РЅР°Р¶Р°С‚Р°, РЅРµС‚ РѕС‚РєСЂС‹С‚С‹С… РјРµРЅСЋ, РёРіСЂРѕРє Р¶РёРІ Рё СЃР°Рј РЅРµ РІ РЅРѕРєР°СѓС‚Рµ
        boolean canTryRevive = keyDown && mc.screen == null
                && mc.player.isAlive()
                && !mc.player.getPersistentData().getBoolean("AAS_IsDowned");

        Entity target = canTryRevive ? findNearestDownedAlly(mc) : null;

        if (target != null) {
            // Р“Р°СЃРёРј РІР°РЅРёР»СЊРЅС‹Р№ F (СЃРІР°Рї СЂСѓРє), С‡С‚РѕР±С‹ РЅРµ РјРµС€Р°Р»
            while (mc.options.keySwapOffhand.consumeClick()) { }

            boolean newTarget = !revivingHeld || target.getId() != reviveTargetId;
            // РЎРµСЂРІРµСЂ РїРѕРґС‚РІРµСЂР¶РґР°РµС‚, С‡С‚Рѕ РїРѕРґСЉС‘Рј РёРґС‘С‚, РїСЂРёСЃС‹Р»Р°СЏ РїРѕР»РѕСЃРєСѓ РїСЂРѕРіСЂРµСЃСЃР° (>= 0)
            boolean serverConfirmed = ClientData.reviveProgressOther >= 0f;

            // START С€Р»С‘Рј РћР”РРќ СЂР°Р· РїСЂРё РЅР°С‡Р°Р»Рµ / СЃРјРµРЅРµ С†РµР»Рё. Р•СЃР»Рё СЃРµСЂРІРµСЂ РЅРµ РїРѕРґС‚РІРµСЂРґРёР»
            // (РЅР°РїСЂРёРјРµСЂ, РѕС‚РєР»РѕРЅРёР» РёР·-Р·Р° СЂР°СЃС…РѕР¶РґРµРЅРёСЏ РїРѕР·РёС†РёР№) - РїРѕРІС‚РѕСЂСЏРµРј СЂР°Р· РІ REVIVE_RESEND_TICKS.
            // РџРѕРІС‚РѕСЂРЅС‹Р№ START РґР»СЏ С‚РѕР№ Р¶Рµ С†РµР»Рё РЅР° СЃРµСЂРІРµСЂРµ Р±РµР·РѕРїР°СЃРµРЅ: РїСЂРѕРіСЂРµСЃСЃ РЅРµ СЃР±СЂР°СЃС‹РІР°РµС‚СЃСЏ.
            if (newTarget || (!serverConfirmed && --reviveResendCooldown <= 0)) {
                PacketHandler.INSTANCE.sendToServer(new PacketReviveHold(true, target.getId()));
                reviveResendCooldown = REVIVE_RESEND_TICKS;
            }
            revivingHeld = true;
            reviveTargetId = target.getId();
        } else if (revivingHeld) {
            // РљР»Р°РІРёС€Сѓ РѕС‚РїСѓСЃС‚РёР»Рё / С†РµР»СЊ РїРѕС‚РµСЂСЏРЅР° - CANCEL, РѕРґРёРЅ СЂР°Р·
            revivingHeld = false;
            reviveTargetId = -1;
            PacketHandler.INSTANCE.sendToServer(new PacketReviveHold(false, -1));
        }
    }

    private static Entity findNearestDownedAlly(Minecraft mc) {
        Entity best = null;
        double bestDistSq = REVIVE_RANGE * REVIVE_RANGE;

        for (Entity e : mc.level.getEntities(mc.player, mc.player.getBoundingBox().inflate(REVIVE_RANGE))) {
            if (!(e instanceof net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player p) || p == mc.player) continue;
            // Р вЂ™Р С’Р вЂ“Р СњР С›: persistentData("AAS_IsDowned") Р Р…Р В° Р С”Р В»Р С‘Р ВµР Р…РЎвЂљР Вµ Р С—РЎР‚Р С•РЎРѓРЎвЂљР В°Р Р†Р В»РЎРЏР ВµРЎвЂљРЎРѓРЎРЏ Р СћР С›Р вЂєР В¬Р С™Р С› Р Т‘Р В»РЎРЏ
            // Р вЂєР С›Р С™Р С’Р вЂєР В¬Р СњР С›Р вЂњР С› Р С‘Р С–РЎР‚Р С•Р С”Р В° (РЎРѓР С. ClientHooks.handleDownedState). Р вЂќР В»РЎРЏ Р вЂ™Р РЋР вЂўР Тђ Р С•РЎРѓРЎвЂљР В°Р В»РЎРЉР Р…РЎвЂ№РЎвЂ¦
            // Р С‘Р С–РЎР‚Р С•Р С”Р С•Р Р† РЎРѓРЎвЂљР В°РЎвЂљРЎС“РЎРѓ "Р Р† Р Р…Р С•Р С”Р Вµ" РЎРѓР С‘Р Р…РЎвЂ¦РЎР‚Р С•Р Р…Р С‘Р В·Р С‘РЎР‚РЎС“Р ВµРЎвЂљРЎРѓРЎРЏ РЎвЂљР С•Р В»РЎРЉР С”Р С• РЎвЂЎР ВµРЎР‚Р ВµР В· ClientData.DOWNED_PLAYERS,
            // Р С—Р С•РЎРЊРЎвЂљР С•Р СРЎС“ Р С—РЎР‚Р С•Р Р†Р ВµРЎР‚Р С”Р В° Р Р…Р В° persistentData Р В·Р Т‘Р ВµРЎРѓРЎРЉ Р Р†РЎРѓР ВµР С–Р Т‘Р В° Р Р†Р С•Р В·Р Р†РЎР‚Р В°РЎвЂ°Р В°Р В»Р В° false Р Т‘Р В»РЎРЏ РЎРѓР С•РЎР‹Р В·Р Р…Р С‘Р С”Р С•Р Р†
            // Р С‘ F Р Р…Р С‘Р С”Р С•Р С–Р Т‘Р В° Р Р…Р Вµ Р Р…Р В°РЎвЂ¦Р С•Р Т‘Р С‘Р В» РЎвЂ Р ВµР В»РЎРЉ Р Т‘Р В»РЎРЏ Р С—Р С•Р Т‘РЎР‰РЎвЂР СР В°.
            if (!ClientData.DOWNED_PLAYERS.contains(p.getId())) continue;

            double d = mc.player.distanceToSqr(p);
            if (d < bestDistSq) {
                bestDistSq = d;
                best = p;
            }
        }
        return best;
    }

    /**
     * Р РЎвЂ°Р ВµРЎвЂљ РЎР‚Р В°Р Р…Р ВµР Р…Р С•Р С–Р С• РЎРѓР С•РЎР‹Р В·Р Р…Р С‘Р С”Р В°, Р Р…Р В° Р С”Р С•РЎвЂљР С•РЎР‚Р С•Р С–Р С• Р С‘Р С–РЎР‚Р С•Р С” РЎРѓР ВµР в„–РЎвЂЎР В°РЎРѓ Р Р…Р В°Р Р†РЎвЂР В» Р Р†Р В·Р С–Р В»РЎРЏР Т‘, Р Т‘Р ВµРЎР‚Р В¶Р В° Р Р† РЎР‚РЎС“Р С”Р Вµ
     * Р С—РЎР‚Р В°Р Р†Р С‘Р В»РЎРЉР Р…РЎвЂ№Р в„– Р С—РЎР‚Р ВµР Т‘Р СР ВµРЎвЂљ Р Т‘Р В»РЎРЏ Р С—Р С•Р Т‘РЎР‰РЎвЂР СР В° (AASConfig.REVIVE_ITEM). Р РЎРѓР С—Р С•Р В»РЎРЉР В·РЎС“Р ВµРЎвЂљРЎРѓРЎРЏ Р СћР С›Р вЂєР В¬Р С™Р С› Р Т‘Р В»РЎРЏ
     * Р Р†Р С‘Р В·РЎС“Р В°Р В»РЎРЉР Р…Р С•Р в„– Р С—Р С•Р Т‘РЎРѓР С”Р В°Р В·Р С”Р С‘ РІР‚вЂќ РЎРѓР В°Р С Р С—Р С•Р Т‘РЎР‰РЎвЂР С Р С—Р С•-Р С—РЎР‚Р ВµР В¶Р Р…Р ВµР СРЎС“ РЎР‚Р В°Р В±Р С•РЎвЂљР В°Р ВµРЎвЂљ РЎвЂЎР ВµРЎР‚Р ВµР В· findNearestDownedAlly
     * (Р С—Р С• Р В±Р В»Р С‘Р В¶Р В°Р в„–РЎв‚¬Р ВµР СРЎС“ Р Р† РЎР‚Р В°Р Т‘Р С‘РЎС“РЎРѓР Вµ), РЎвЂЎРЎвЂљР С•Р В±РЎвЂ№ Р Р…Р Вµ Р В»Р С•Р СР В°РЎвЂљРЎРЉ Р Р†Р С•Р В·Р СР С•Р В¶Р Р…Р С•РЎРѓРЎвЂљРЎРЉ Р С—Р С•Р Т‘Р Р…РЎРЏРЎвЂљРЎРЉ Р С‘Р С–РЎР‚Р С•Р С”Р В°,
     * Р В»Р ВµР В¶Р В°РЎвЂ°Р ВµР С–Р С• Р С—Р С•РЎвЂЎРЎвЂљР С‘ Р Р†Р С—Р В»Р С•РЎвЂљР Р…РЎС“РЎР‹ (РЎС“ Р Р…Р С‘РЎвЂ¦ Р С•РЎвЂЎР ВµР Р…РЎРЉ Р Р…Р С‘Р В·Р С”Р С‘Р в„– РЎвЂ¦Р С‘РЎвЂљР В±Р С•Р С”РЎРѓ Р Р† Р С—Р С•Р В·Р Вµ SWIMMING, Р С‘ РЎС“Р В·Р С”Р С‘Р в„–
     * РЎР‚Р ВµР в„–Р С”Р В°РЎРѓРЎвЂљ Р С—Р С• Р Р…Р ВµР СРЎС“ РЎвЂЎР В°РЎРѓРЎвЂљР С• Р С—РЎР‚Р С•Р СР В°РЎвЂ¦Р С‘Р Р†Р В°Р ВµРЎвЂљРЎРѓРЎРЏ).
     */
    private static Entity findRevivePromptTarget(Minecraft mc) {
        if (mc.player == null || mc.level == null) return null;
        if (mc.screen != null) return null;
        if (!mc.player.isAlive() || mc.player.getPersistentData().getBoolean("AAS_IsDowned")) return null;

        String reviveItemName = ClientData.serverReviveItem; // Р±С‹Р»Рѕ: AASConfig.REVIVE_ITEM.get()
        net.minecraft.world.item.Item reviveItem = ForgeRegistries.ITEMS.getValue(new ResourceLocation(reviveItemName));
        if (reviveItem == null || (mc.player.getMainHandItem().getItem() != reviveItem && mc.player.getOffhandItem().getItem() != reviveItem)) return null;

        Vec3 eye = mc.player.getEyePosition(1.0f);
        Vec3 look = mc.player.getViewVector(1.0f).normalize();

        Entity best = null;
        double bestDot = REVIVE_AIM_DOT_THRESHOLD;

        for (Entity e : mc.level.getEntities(mc.player, mc.player.getBoundingBox().inflate(REVIVE_RANGE))) {
            if (!(e instanceof Player p) || p == mc.player) continue;
            // Р РЋР С. Р С”Р С•Р СР СР ВµР Р…РЎвЂљР В°РЎР‚Р С‘Р в„– Р Р† findNearestDownedAlly РІР‚вЂќ Р Т‘Р В»РЎРЏ РЎвЂЎРЎС“Р В¶Р С‘РЎвЂ¦ Р С‘Р С–РЎР‚Р С•Р С”Р С•Р Р† Р Р…РЎС“Р В¶Р Р…Р С• Р С—РЎР‚Р С•Р Р†Р ВµРЎР‚РЎРЏРЎвЂљРЎРЉ
            // Р С‘Р СР ВµР Р…Р Р…Р С• ClientData.DOWNED_PLAYERS, Р В° Р Р…Р Вµ Р С‘РЎвЂ¦ persistentData.
            if (!ClientData.DOWNED_PLAYERS.contains(p.getId())) continue;
            if (mc.player.distanceTo(p) > REVIVE_RANGE) continue;

            Vec3 toTarget = p.position().add(0, p.getBbHeight() * 0.5 + 0.15, 0).subtract(eye).normalize();
            double dot = look.dot(toTarget);
            if (dot > bestDot) {
                bestDot = dot;
                best = p;
            }
        }
        return best;
    }

    /**
     * Р Р Р…Р С•РЎвЂЎР Р…РЎвЂ№Р в„– 3D-Р СР В°РЎР‚Р С”Р ВµРЎР‚ Р Р…Р В°Р Т‘ РЎР‚Р В°Р Р…Р ВµР Р…РЎвЂ№Р С: РЎвЂЎРЎвЂРЎР‚Р Р…РЎвЂ№Р в„– Р С—Р С•Р В»РЎС“Р С—РЎР‚Р С•Р В·РЎР‚Р В°РЎвЂЎР Р…РЎвЂ№Р в„– Р С”Р Р†Р В°Р Т‘РЎР‚Р В°РЎвЂљ РЎРѓ Р В±Р ВµР В»Р С•Р в„– Р С•Р В±Р Р†Р С•Р Т‘Р С”Р С•Р в„–,
     * Р В±РЎС“Р С”Р Р†Р В° "F" Р Р† РЎвЂ Р ВµР Р…РЎвЂљРЎР‚Р Вµ Р С‘ Р С—Р С•Р Т‘Р С—Р С‘РЎРѓРЎРЉ РЎРѓР С—РЎР‚Р В°Р Р†Р В°.
     */
    private static void renderRevivePrompt(PoseStack poseStack, Vec3 cameraPos, Entity target, Minecraft mc, float partialTick) {
        poseStack.pushPose();

        double tx = Mth.lerp(partialTick, target.xOld, target.getX());
        double ty = Mth.lerp(partialTick, target.yOld, target.getY());
        double tz = Mth.lerp(partialTick, target.zOld, target.getZ());

        double renderX = tx - cameraPos.x;
        double renderY = ty + target.getBbHeight() + 0.05 - cameraPos.y; // Р±С‹Р»Рѕ + 0.55
        double renderZ = tz - cameraPos.z;
        poseStack.translate(renderX, renderY, renderZ);

        poseStack.mulPose(mc.getEntityRenderDispatcher().cameraOrientation());

        // Р  Р В°Р В·Р СР ВµРЎР‚ Р СР В°РЎР‚Р С”Р ВµРЎР‚Р В° РЎС“Р СР ВµР Р…РЎРЉРЎв‚¬Р ВµР Р… Р Р† 4 РЎР‚Р В°Р В·Р В° Р С—Р С• РЎРѓРЎР‚Р В°Р Р†Р Р…Р ВµР Р…Р С‘РЎР‹ РЎРѓ Р С‘РЎРѓРЎвЂ¦Р С•Р Т‘Р Р…РЎвЂ№Р С (0.025f -> 0.00625f)
        float scale = 0.00625f;
        double dist = mc.player.distanceTo(target);
        scale *= (float) Math.max(1.0, dist / 2.5);
        scale = Math.min(scale, 0.0125f);
        poseStack.scale(-scale, -scale, scale);

        Matrix4f matrix = poseStack.last().pose();

        RenderSystem.enableBlend();
        RenderSystem.defaultBlendFunc();
        RenderSystem.disableDepthTest();
        RenderSystem.setShader(net.minecraft.client.renderer.GameRenderer::getPositionColorShader);

        Tesselator tesselator = Tesselator.getInstance();
        BufferBuilder buf = tesselator.getBuilder();

        float half = 13f;

        // 1. Р В§РЎвЂРЎР‚Р Р…РЎвЂ№Р в„– Р С—Р С•Р В»РЎС“Р С—РЎР‚Р С•Р В·РЎР‚Р В°РЎвЂЎР Р…РЎвЂ№Р в„– РЎвЂћР С•Р Р…-Р С”Р Р†Р В°Р Т‘РЎР‚Р В°РЎвЂљ
        buf.begin(VertexFormat.Mode.QUADS, DefaultVertexFormat.POSITION_COLOR);
        quad(buf, matrix, -half, -half, half, half, 0, 0, 0, 140);
        tesselator.end();

        // 2. Р вЂР ВµР В»Р В°РЎРЏ Р С•Р В±Р Р†Р С•Р Т‘Р С”Р В° (4 РЎвЂљР С•Р Р…Р С”Р С‘РЎвЂ¦ Р С—Р С•Р В»Р С•РЎРѓР С”Р С‘ Р С—Р С• Р С—Р ВµРЎР‚Р С‘Р СР ВµРЎвЂљРЎР‚РЎС“)
        float t = 1.2f;
        buf.begin(VertexFormat.Mode.QUADS, DefaultVertexFormat.POSITION_COLOR);
        quad(buf, matrix, -half, -half, half, -half + t, 255, 255, 255, 230);      // Р Р†Р ВµРЎР‚РЎвЂ¦
        quad(buf, matrix, -half, half - t, half, half, 255, 255, 255, 230);        // Р Р…Р С‘Р В·
        quad(buf, matrix, -half, -half, -half + t, half, 255, 255, 255, 230);      // Р В»Р ВµР Р†Р В°РЎРЏ
        quad(buf, matrix, half - t, -half, half, half, 255, 255, 255, 230);        // Р С—РЎР‚Р В°Р Р†Р В°РЎРЏ
        tesselator.end();

        RenderSystem.setShaderColor(1, 1, 1, 1);

        // 3. Р вЂРЎС“Р С”Р Р†Р В° Р Р† РЎвЂ Р ВµР Р…РЎвЂљРЎР‚Р Вµ Р С”Р Р†Р В°Р Т‘РЎР‚Р В°РЎвЂљР В° РІР‚вЂќ Р вЂќР Р СњР С’Р СљР Р В§Р вЂўР РЋР С™Р С’Р Р‡: Р В±Р ВµРЎР‚РЎвЂРЎвЂљРЎРѓРЎРЏ Р С‘Р В· РЎвЂљР ВµР С”РЎС“РЎвЂ°Р ВµР С–Р С• Р В±Р С‘Р Р…Р Т‘Р В° REVIVE_KEY,
        // Р Р…Р С• Р Р†РЎРѓР ВµР С–Р Т‘Р В° Р С•РЎвЂљР С•Р В±РЎР‚Р В°Р В¶Р В°Р ВµРЎвЂљРЎРѓРЎРЏ Р В°Р Р…Р С–Р В»Р С‘Р в„–РЎРѓР С”Р С‘Р С РЎРѓР С‘Р СР Р†Р С•Р В»Р С•Р С (Р Р…Р Вµ Р В·Р В°Р Р†Р С‘РЎРѓР С‘РЎвЂљ Р С•РЎвЂљ РЎРЏР В·РЎвЂ№Р С”Р В° Р С‘Р С–РЎР‚РЎвЂ№/РЎР‚Р В°РЎРѓР С”Р В»Р В°Р Т‘Р С”Р С‘)
        Font font = mc.font;
        MultiBufferSource.BufferSource buffer = mc.renderBuffers().bufferSource();

        String letter = getReviveKeyLabel();
        float lw = font.width(letter);
        // Р±С‹Р»Рѕ: font.drawInBatch(letter, -lw / 2f, -4f, 0xFFFFFFFF, false, matrix, buffer, Font.DisplayMode.NORMAL, 0, 15728880);
        font.drawInBatch(letter, -lw / 2f, -4f, 0xFFFFFFFF, false,
                matrix, buffer, Font.DisplayMode.NORMAL, 0, 15728880); // РѕСЃС‚Р°РІР»СЏРµРј РєР°Рє РµСЃС‚СЊ вЂ” СЌС‚Рѕ СѓР¶Рµ С‡РёСЃС‚С‹Р№ Р±РµР»С‹Р№

// РїРѕРґРїРёСЃСЊ СЂСЏРґРѕРј вЂ” СѓР±РёСЂР°РµРј С‚РµРЅРµРІСѓСЋ РїРѕРґР»РѕР¶РєСѓ 0x55000000, С‡С‚РѕР±С‹ РЅРµ РґР°РІР°Р»Р° СЃРµСЂС‹Р№ РѕС‚С‚РµРЅРѕРє
        poseStack.pushPose();
        poseStack.translate(half + 6f, -4f, 0f);
        Matrix4f textMatrix = poseStack.last().pose();
        font.drawInBatch(I18n.get("aas.hud.revive_prompt"), 0, 0, 0xFFFFFFFF, false,
                textMatrix, buffer, Font.DisplayMode.NORMAL, 0, 15728880); // false РІРјРµСЃС‚Рѕ true, 0 РІРјРµСЃС‚Рѕ 0x55000000
        poseStack.popPose();

        buffer.endBatch();

        RenderSystem.enableDepthTest();
        poseStack.popPose();
    }

    /**
     * Р вЂ™Р С•Р В·Р Р†РЎР‚Р В°РЎвЂ°Р В°Р ВµРЎвЂљ Р С•РЎвЂљР С•Р В±РЎР‚Р В°Р В¶Р В°Р ВµР СР С•Р Вµ Р С‘Р СРЎРЏ РЎвЂљР ВµР С”РЎС“РЎвЂ°Р ВµР в„– Р С”Р В»Р В°Р Р†Р С‘РЎв‚¬Р С‘ Р С—Р С•Р Т‘РЎР‰РЎвЂР СР В° (ModKeyBindings.REVIVE_KEY).
     * Р вЂќР В»РЎРЏ Р В±РЎС“Р С”Р Р† Р С‘ РЎвЂ Р С‘РЎвЂћРЎР‚ (A-Z, 0-9) Р Р†РЎРѓР ВµР С–Р Т‘Р В° Р Р†Р С•Р В·Р Р†РЎР‚Р В°РЎвЂ°Р В°Р ВµРЎвЂљ Р В»Р В°РЎвЂљР С‘Р Р…РЎРѓР С”Р С‘Р в„– РЎРѓР С‘Р СР Р†Р С•Р В» Р Р…Р В°Р С—РЎР‚РЎРЏР СРЎС“РЎР‹ Р С‘Р В·
     * GLFW-Р С”Р С•Р Т‘Р В° Р С”Р В»Р В°Р Р†Р С‘РЎв‚¬Р С‘ (Р С•Р Р… РЎР‚Р В°Р Р†Р ВµР Р… ASCII-Р С”Р С•Р Т‘РЎС“), РЎвЂЎРЎвЂљР С•Р В±РЎвЂ№ Р В±РЎС“Р С”Р Р†Р В° Р Р…Р Вµ Р С—Р ВµРЎР‚Р ВµР Р†Р С•Р Т‘Р С‘Р В»Р В°РЎРѓРЎРЉ/Р Р…Р Вµ
     * Р В·Р В°Р Р†Р С‘РЎРѓР ВµР В»Р В° Р С•РЎвЂљ РЎРЏР В·РЎвЂ№Р С”Р В° Р С‘Р С–РЎР‚РЎвЂ№. Р вЂќР В»РЎРЏ Р С•РЎРѓРЎвЂљР В°Р В»РЎРЉР Р…РЎвЂ№РЎвЂ¦ Р С”Р В»Р В°Р Р†Р С‘РЎв‚¬ (Shift, Р С—РЎР‚Р С•Р В±Р ВµР В», Р С”Р Р…Р С•Р С—Р С”Р С‘ Р СРЎвЂ№РЎв‚¬Р С‘ Р С‘ РЎвЂљ.Р Т‘.)
     * Р С‘РЎРѓР С—Р С•Р В»РЎРЉР В·РЎС“Р ВµРЎвЂљРЎРѓРЎРЏ Р Р†Р В°Р Р…Р С‘Р В»РЎРЉР Р…Р С•Р Вµ Р С•РЎвЂљР С•Р В±РЎР‚Р В°Р В¶Р В°Р ВµР СР С•Р Вµ Р С‘Р СРЎРЏ Р С”Р В»Р В°Р Р†Р С‘РЎв‚¬Р С‘.
     */
    private static String getReviveKeyLabel() {
        InputConstants.Key key = ModKeyBindings.REVIVE_KEY.getKey();

        if (key.getType() == InputConstants.Type.KEYSYM) {
            int v = key.getValue();
            if (v >= org.lwjgl.glfw.GLFW.GLFW_KEY_A && v <= org.lwjgl.glfw.GLFW.GLFW_KEY_Z) {
                return String.valueOf((char) v); // GLFW_KEY_A..Z РЎРѓР С•Р Р†Р С—Р В°Р Т‘Р В°РЎР‹РЎвЂљ РЎРѓ ASCII 'A'..'Z'
            }
            if (v >= org.lwjgl.glfw.GLFW.GLFW_KEY_0 && v <= org.lwjgl.glfw.GLFW.GLFW_KEY_9) {
                return String.valueOf((char) v); // GLFW_KEY_0..9 РЎРѓР С•Р Р†Р С—Р В°Р Т‘Р В°РЎР‹РЎвЂљ РЎРѓ ASCII '0'..'9'
            }
        }

        // Р Р…Р Вµ-Р В±РЎС“Р С”Р Р†Р ВµР Р…Р Р…Р В°РЎРЏ Р С”Р В»Р В°Р Р†Р С‘РЎв‚¬Р В° (Shift, Р С—РЎР‚Р С•Р В±Р ВµР В», Р С”Р Р…Р С•Р С—Р С”Р В° Р СРЎвЂ№РЎв‚¬Р С‘ Р С‘ РЎвЂљ.Р Т‘.) РІР‚вЂќ Р С•Р В±РЎвЂ№РЎвЂЎР Р…Р С•Р Вµ Р С•РЎвЂљР С•Р В±РЎР‚Р В°Р В¶Р ВµР Р…Р С‘Р Вµ
        return key.getDisplayName().getString();
    }

    private static void quad(BufferBuilder buf, Matrix4f matrix, float x1, float y1, float x2, float y2, int r, int g, int b, int a) {
        buf.vertex(matrix, x1, y2, 0).color(r, g, b, a).endVertex();
        buf.vertex(matrix, x2, y2, 0).color(r, g, b, a).endVertex();
        buf.vertex(matrix, x2, y1, 0).color(r, g, b, a).endVertex();
        buf.vertex(matrix, x1, y1, 0).color(r, g, b, a).endVertex();
    }
    // РџСЂРѕРІРµСЂСЏРµС‚ РїСЂРѕРіСЂРµСЃСЃ РёРіСЂРѕРєР° Рё РїРѕРєР°Р·С‹РІР°РµС‚ РїРѕРґСЃРєР°Р·РєРё:
    // - "РІС‹Р±РµСЂРё РєРѕРјР°РЅРґСѓ" - РѕРґРёРЅ СЂР°Р· Р·Р° СЃРµСЃСЃРёСЋ, СЃРѕ Р·РІСѓРєРѕРј;
    // - "РІС‹Р±РµСЂРё РѕС‚СЂСЏРґ" - РєР°Р¶РґС‹Р№ СЂР°Р· Р·Р°РЅРѕРІРѕ, РєРѕРіРґР° РёРіСЂРѕРє С‚РµСЂСЏРµС‚ РѕС‚СЂСЏРґ (РІС‹С€РµР»/РєРёРєРЅСѓР»Рё), Р±РµР· Р·РІСѓРєР°;
    // - "РІС‹Р±РµСЂРё СЃРЅР°СЂСЏР¶РµРЅРёРµ" - РєР°Р¶РґС‹Р№ СЂР°Р· Р·Р°РЅРѕРІРѕ, РєРѕРіРґР° РёРіСЂРѕРє РІСЃС‚СѓРїР°РµС‚ РІ РѕС‚СЂСЏРґ Р±РµР· РєРёС‚Р°, Р±РµР· Р·РІСѓРєР°.
    private static void checkOnboardingHints(Minecraft mc) {
        if (mc.player == null) return;

        String teamName = (mc.player.getTeam() != null) ? mc.player.getTeam().getName() : "";
        boolean hasTeam = teamName.equalsIgnoreCase("Blue") || teamName.equalsIgnoreCase("Red");

        // Р’РђР–РќРћ: getPersistentData() СЃРµСЂРІРµСЂР° РќР• СЃРёРЅС…СЂРѕРЅРёР·РёСЂСѓРµС‚СЃСЏ РЅР° РєР»РёРµРЅС‚ - РёСЃРїРѕР»СЊР·СѓРµРј
        // СЂРµР°Р»СЊРЅРѕ СЃРёРЅС…СЂРѕРЅРёР·РёСЂСѓРµРјС‹Рµ РёСЃС‚РѕС‡РЅРёРєРё (РєР°Рє Рё РѕСЃС‚Р°Р»СЊРЅРѕР№ РєР»РёРµРЅС‚СЃРєРёР№ РєРѕРґ РјРѕРґР°).
        String myName = mc.player.getScoreboardName();
        boolean hasSquad = ClientData.clientSquads.stream()
                .anyMatch(s -> s.members.contains(myName));
        boolean hasKit = ClientData.myCurrentKit != null
                && !ClientData.myCurrentKit.isEmpty()
                && !ClientData.myCurrentKit.equalsIgnoreCase("Unassigned");

        String keyName = ModKeyBindings.OPEN_SQUAD_MENU_KEY.getTranslatedKeyMessage().getString();

        if (!hintsInitialized) {
            hintsInitialized = true;
            prevHasSquad = hasSquad;
        }

        if (prevHasSquad && !hasSquad) {
            squadHintShown = false;
        }
        if (!prevHasSquad && hasSquad) {
            kitHintShown = false;
            ClientData.squadPanelExpanded = true;
        }
        prevHasSquad = hasSquad;

        if (!hasTeam) {
            if (!teamHintShown) {
                teamHintShown = true;
                showHintToast(mc, "aas.hint.team.title", "aas.hint.team.desc", keyName, true);
            }
        } else if (!hasSquad) {
            if (!squadHintShown) {
                squadHintShown = true;
                showHintToast(mc, "aas.hint.squad.title", "aas.hint.squad.desc", keyName, false);
            }
        } else if (!hasKit) {
            if (!kitHintShown) {
                kitHintShown = true;
                showHintToast(mc, "aas.hint.kit.title", "aas.hint.kit.desc", keyName, false);
            }
        }
    }

    // РЎС‚Р°РЅРґР°СЂС‚РЅС‹Р№ РёРіСЂРѕРІРѕР№ toast (РєР°Рє РІР°РЅРёР»СЊРЅС‹Рµ С‚СѓС‚РѕСЂРёР°Р»СЊРЅС‹Рµ РїРѕРґСЃРєР°Р·РєРё).
    // withSound - С‚РѕР»СЊРєРѕ РґР»СЏ СЃР°РјРѕР№ РїРµСЂРІРѕР№ РїРѕРґСЃРєР°Р·РєРё (РІС‹Р±РѕСЂ РєРѕРјР°РЅРґС‹), РѕСЃС‚Р°Р»СЊРЅС‹Рµ С‚РёС…РёРµ, С‡С‚РѕР±С‹ РЅРµ СЂР°Р·РґСЂР°Р¶Р°С‚СЊ
    // РїСЂРё РїРѕРІС‚РѕСЂРЅС‹С… СЃСЂР°Р±Р°С‚С‹РІР°РЅРёСЏС… (РєРёРє РёР· РѕС‚СЂСЏРґР° Рё С‚.Рї.).
    private static void showHintToast(Minecraft mc, String titleKey, String descKey, String keyName, boolean withSound) {
        Component title = Component.translatable(titleKey);
        Component desc = Component.translatable(descKey, keyName);

        net.minecraft.client.gui.components.toasts.SystemToast.addOrUpdate(
                mc.getToasts(),
                net.minecraft.client.gui.components.toasts.SystemToast.SystemToastIds.TUTORIAL_HINT,
                title,
                desc
        );

        if (withSound) {
            mc.getSoundManager().play(net.minecraft.client.resources.sounds.SimpleSoundInstance.forUI(
                    net.minecraft.sounds.SoundEvents.EXPERIENCE_ORB_PICKUP, 1.4F, 0.6F));
        }
    }
}

public class ClientHooks {
    public static void handleRecoil(float pitch, float yaw) {
        com.example.aas.client.RecoilHandler.addRecoil(pitch);
        if (yaw != 0 && net.minecraft.client.Minecraft.getInstance().player != null) {
            net.minecraft.client.Minecraft.getInstance().player.turn(yaw, 0);
        }
    }
    // === Р”Р›РЇ Р РђР›Р›РРљРђ ===
    public static Object playRallySound(RallyPointBlockEntity entity, Object currentSound) {
        Minecraft mc = Minecraft.getInstance();
        if (currentSound != null && mc.getSoundManager().isActive((net.minecraft.client.resources.sounds.SoundInstance) currentSound)) {
            return currentSound;
        }
        com.example.aas.client.sound.RallyLoopingSound newSound = new com.example.aas.client.sound.RallyLoopingSound(entity);
        mc.getSoundManager().play(newSound);
        return newSound;
    }
    public static void openPlayerKitMenu(List<PacketOpenPlayerKitMenu.KitDTO> kits) {
        if (net.minecraft.client.Minecraft.getInstance().screen instanceof PlayerKitSelectScreen screen) {
            screen.updateKits(kits); // РћР±РЅРѕРІР»СЏРµРј РІ СЂРµР°Р»СЊРЅРѕРј РІСЂРµРјРµРЅРё
        } else {
            net.minecraft.client.Minecraft.getInstance().setScreen(new PlayerKitSelectScreen(kits));
        }
    }
    public static void stopRallySound(Object sound) {
        if (sound instanceof RallyLoopingSound s) {
            s.stopSound();
        }

    public static void tryOpenRadioMenu(net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player player) {
        if (player.isCreative()) {
            openRadioMenu();
            return;
        }

        if (player.getTeam() == null) {
            player.displayClientMessage(net.minecraft.network.chat.Component.literal("You must join a TEAM (Blue/Red) first!").withStyle(net.minecraft.ChatFormatting.RED), true);
            return;
        }

        String playerName = player.getScoreboardName();
        boolean isInSquad = false;
        boolean isLeader = false;

        // Р—РґРµСЃСЊ Р±РµР·РѕРїР°СЃРЅРѕ РёСЃРїРѕР»СЊР·СѓРµРј ClientData, С‚Р°Рє РєР°Рє РјС‹ РІ РєР»РёРµРЅС‚СЃРєРѕРј РєР»Р°СЃСЃРµ
        for (com.example.aas.world.AASWorldData.Squad s : ClientData.clientSquads) {
            if (s.members.contains(playerName)) {
                isInSquad = true;
                if (s.leader.equals(playerName)) {
                    isLeader = true;
                }
                break;
            }
        }

        if (!isInSquad) {
            player.displayClientMessage(net.minecraft.network.chat.Component.literal("You must join a SQUAD first! Press 'K'.").withStyle(net.minecraft.ChatFormatting.RED), true);
            return;
        }

        if (!isLeader) {
            player.displayClientMessage(net.minecraft.network.chat.Component.literal("You must be a Squad Leader to use this!").withStyle(net.minecraft.ChatFormatting.RED), true);
            return;
        }

        // Р•СЃР»Рё РІСЃС‘ РѕРє - РѕС‚РєСЂС‹РІР°РµРј РјРµРЅСЋ
        openRadioMenu();
    }

    public static void handleSpawnGhost(PacketSpawnGhost msg) {
        Level level = Minecraft.getInstance().level;
        if (level != null) {
            Display.BlockDisplay ghost = new Display.BlockDisplay(EntityType.BLOCK_DISPLAY, level);
            if (msg.blockId == 14) {
                CompoundTag tag = new CompoundTag();
                tag.put("block_state", NbtUtils.writeBlockState(ModBlocks.HUB_BLOCK.get().defaultBlockState()));
                ghost.load(tag);
            }
            ghost.setPos(msg.pos.getX(), msg.pos.getY(), msg.pos.getZ());
            level.addFreshEntity(ghost);
        }
    }
    public static void handleDownedState(int entityId, boolean isDowned, boolean died) {
        net.minecraft.client.Minecraft mc = net.minecraft.client.Minecraft.getInstance();
        if (mc.level == null) return;

        if (isDowned) {
            com.example.aas.client.ClientData.DOWNED_PLAYERS.add(entityId);
            if (mc.player != null && mc.player.getId() == entityId) {
                mc.player.getPersistentData().putBoolean("AAS_IsDowned", true);

                // Р¤РРљРЎ: РЈСЃС‚Р°РЅР°РІР»РёРІР°РµРј РІСЂРµРјСЏ С‚РѕР»СЊРєРѕ РµСЃР»Рё РѕРЅРѕ РµС‰Рµ РЅРµ СѓСЃС‚Р°РЅРѕРІР»РµРЅРѕ
                if (com.example.aas.client.ClientData.globalDeathTimestamp == 0) {
                    com.example.aas.client.ClientData.globalDeathTimestamp = System.currentTimeMillis();
                }
                mc.setScreen(new com.example.aas.client.gui.DownedScreen());
            }
        } else {
            com.example.aas.client.ClientData.DOWNED_PLAYERS.remove(entityId);

            if (mc.player != null && mc.player.getId() == entityId) {
                mc.player.getPersistentData().putBoolean("AAS_IsDowned", false);

                if (mc.screen instanceof com.example.aas.client.gui.DownedScreen) {
                    mc.setScreen(null);
                }

                // РЎР±СЂР°СЃС‹РІР°РµРј С‚Р°Р№РјРµСЂ РўРћР›Р¬РљРћ РїСЂРё РЅР°СЃС‚РѕСЏС‰РµРј РїРѕРґСЉС‘РјРµ РјРµРґРёРєРѕРј.
                // Р•СЃР»Рё СЌС‚Рѕ Give Up/Р°РІС‚Рѕ-Р±РёРґР°СѓС‚ (died = true) вЂ” РЅРµ С‚СЂРѕРіР°РµРј,
                // РІСЂРµРјСЏ РІ РЅРѕРєРµ РґРѕР»Р¶РЅРѕ РґРѕРЅРµСЃС‚РёСЃСЊ РґРѕ СЌРєСЂР°РЅР° СЃРјРµСЂС‚Рё.
                if (!died) { // Р•СЃР»Рё СЂРµР°Р»СЊРЅРѕ РїРѕРґРЅСЏР»Рё, Р° РЅРµ СѓР±РёР»Рё РѕРєРѕРЅС‡Р°С‚РµР»СЊРЅРѕ
                    com.example.aas.client.ClientData.globalDeathTimestamp = 0;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void handleDragState(boolean isDragging) {
        net.minecraft.client.Minecraft mc = net.minecraft.client.Minecraft.getInstance();
        if (mc.player == null) return;
        mc.player.getPersistentData().putBoolean("AAS_IsDraggingAlly", isDragging);
    }

    public static void handleSyncPoint(PacketSyncPoint msg) {
        ClientData.isInsidePoint = msg.isInside;

        // Р•СЃР»Рё РїР°РєРµС‚ РїСѓСЃС‚РѕР№ (СЃРµСЂРІРµСЂ С€Р»РµС‚ РµРіРѕ, С‡С‚РѕР±С‹ СЃРєСЂС‹С‚СЊ РїР»Р°С€РєСѓ HUD Сѓ С‚РµС…, РєС‚Рѕ РІРЅРµ С‚РѕС‡РєРё)
        if (msg.name.isEmpty()) {
            ClientData.pointName = "";
            return;
        }

        // Р•СЃР»Рё РёРіСЂРѕРє С„РёР·РёС‡РµСЃРєРё СЃС‚РѕРёС‚ РЅР° С‚РѕС‡РєРµ - РѕР±РЅРѕРІР»СЏРµРј РґР°РЅРЅС‹Рµ РґР»СЏ С†РµРЅС‚СЂР°Р»СЊРЅРѕРіРѕ HUD
        if (msg.isInside) {
            ClientData.pointName = msg.name;
            ClientData.pointOwner = msg.owner;
            ClientData.pointProgress = msg.progress;
            ClientData.isLocked = msg.isLocked;
            ClientData.nextObjectiveName = msg.nextObjective;
            ClientData.lockSecondsLeft = msg.lockSecondsLeft;
            ClientData.isContested = msg.isContested;
            ClientData.pointCapturingTeam = msg.capturingTeam;
            ClientData.pointCaptureRate = msg.captureRate;
        }

        // === Р“Р›РћР‘РђР›Р¬РќРћР• РћР‘РќРћР’Р›Р•РќРР• РљРђР РўР« ===
        // РћР±РЅРѕРІР»СЏРµРј СЃС‚Р°С‚СѓСЃ С‚РѕС‡РєРё РІ РєСЌС€Рµ РєР°СЂС‚С‹ (СЂР°Р±РѕС‚Р°РµС‚ РґР»СЏ РІСЃРµС… РёРіСЂРѕРєРѕРІ РЅР° СЃРµСЂРІРµСЂРµ!)
        if (ClientData.allCapturePoints != null) {
            for (AASWorldData.CapturePoint cp : ClientData.allCapturePoints) {
                if (cp.name.equals(msg.name)) {
                    cp.owner = msg.owner;
                    cp.progress = msg.progress;
                    cp.capturingTeam = msg.capturingTeam;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static Object playStationSound(VehicleStationBlockEntity entity, Object currentSound) {
        net.minecraft.client.Minecraft mc = net.minecraft.client.Minecraft.getInstance();
        System.out.println("[AAS DEBUG] playStationSound called, currentSound=" + currentSound);

        if (currentSound != null && mc.getSoundManager().isActive((net.minecraft.client.resources.sounds.SoundInstance) currentSound)) {
            System.out.println("[AAS DEBUG] sound already active, skip");
            return currentSound;
        }

        com.example.aas.client.sound.StationLoopingSound newSound = new com.example.aas.client.sound.StationLoopingSound(entity);
        System.out.println("[AAS DEBUG] creating new StationLoopingSound and calling play()");
        mc.getSoundManager().play(newSound);
        return newSound;
    }

        // Р•СЃР»Рё РёРіСЂРѕРє С‚РѕР»СЊРєРѕ РЅР°С‡Р°Р» РіРѕРІРѕСЂРёС‚СЊ - РїСЂРѕРёРіСЂС‹РІР°РµРј РїРёРї (РєРѕРґ РІС‹РїРѕР»РЅСЏРµС‚СЃСЏ СЃС‚СЂРѕРіРѕ РЅР° РєР»РёРµРЅС‚Рµ)
        if (isNewSpeaker) {
            net.minecraft.client.Minecraft.getInstance().getSoundManager().play(
